title: GenerateTextResponse
description: The response from the model, including candidate completions.

safetyFeedback.description: Returns any safety feedback related to content filtering.

filters.description: A set of content filtering metadata for the prompt and response text. This indicates which `SafetyCategory`(s) blocked a candidate from this response, the lowest `HarmProbability` that triggered a block, and the HarmThreshold setting for that category. This indicates the smallest change to the `SafetySettings` that would be necessary to unblock at least 1 response. The blocking is configured by the `SafetySettings` in the request (or the default `SafetySettings` of the API).
